name: ggwhite/4x
summary: Cross-agent Design/Code/Review/Test runtime with first-class Codex support, using per-criterion verification types, executable evidence, and Go-enforced gates.
evidence: The workflow separates design, coding, review, testing, deep review, and acceptance into isolated roles while the Go runtime controls phase transitions and artifact boundaries.
Its test strategy maps acceptance-criterion IDs to verification types and optional executable `ac_checks`; the verifier records command exit codes and evidence per criterion.

Go guards recompute `ac_checks` results from recorded commands and exit codes, reject skipped or inconsistent checks, require evidence for non-skipped criteria, and enforce screenshot and manual-check obligations when configured.

The verifier rejects obvious fake checks such as empty commands, no-op commands, echo-only commands, and source-only grep checks, while the Codex adapter can run every workflow role through `codex exec --json`.
